subject: Polaris dossier evaluation harness (TRACKER G5, gap #10): evaluateDossier and poc:dossier-evaluation, after the #261 review repairs (blob-absolute quotes, subject digests, label honesty, reader factory, non-file refusal)
method: Each mutant replaced exactly one fragment (asserted to occur once) in the named file, ran both test files (npx vitest run <core test> <app test>, 38 tests), and restored the file; the worktree was clean afterwards. A mutant is killed when at least one test fails.
tests: packages/polaris-generation-core/src/dossier-evaluation.test.ts (32) and apps/three-surface-poc/src/polaris-generation/dossier-evaluation-main.test.ts (6); all fixtures synthetic, no external repository read, no provider call
history: At 2b5500ff a mutant deleting the head-text guard (`if (inHead()) return;`) survived: <title>, the only text-bearing head element, was already skipped as raw text. The guard was removed as redundant in the next commit, and the mutant replaced by title-counted, which removes title from the raw-text set.

At fefad720 the first record held 17 mutants, all killed. The #261 review (CHANGES at d1591dcb) renamed the coverage status, the claims pass word and the reader input; the five affected fragments were re-pointed to the renamed code, and twelve mutants were added for the repairs.

At cdd24994 body-not-digested (the sources digest ignoring body bytes) survived: the only changed-bytes case also changed the object id. c4dab877 adds a body swapped under the same identity; this run is at that commit.

At c4dab877, 29 of 29 were killed. #261 then merged with a two-letter content-coding literal in the void-element set, and governance-docs C3 failed on main. #274 builds the same set from one string, and this run is at those bytes.
